message:
After 24 years of marriage, Mark and I suddenly realised something rather shocking — we had never had a full week away together, just the two of us, without the children or grandchildren!

So, for the first time ever, we decided to close the office doors for a whole week and enjoy some much-needed time together.

Of course, with all the beautiful weather we’ve been having, we managed to pick the one week that brought torrential rain and thunderstorms! 😂

We started off in our lovely, secluded little beach hut in Devon, but after being thoroughly soaked, we decided it was time for a change of scenery. So, we packed up and headed to Bath and Bristol for a couple of nights instead.

It hasn’t quite gone to plan, but had a wonderful time together — and, after 24 years, we’re certainly not going to let a bit of British weather spoil it! ❤️
